request.subject: UNIT:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Change only the colours of the sail and pennant: the big red sail becomes deep crimson cloth, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with a thin gold-yellow border and one big gold-yellow cross in its middle; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip; add a thin gold-yellow trim along the top rail. Keep the pale wooden hull, mast, boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
